wiki_article:
**CRIMSON HEXAGON: CENTRAL NAVIGATION MAP v4.1** is a navigation document by Lee Sharks, **Rex Fraction**, **Rebekah Cranes** and **the Assembly**, deposited 17 January 2026.

It integrates a January 2026 snapshot of **ninety-five archive documents, six named Assembly operator roles, three institutions, and a three-layer architecture**, recording rooms, systems and operators in one machine-readable surface.

The figures date the corpus precisely: ninety-five documents here, **109 by v4.2** the next day (#326), 387 by March (#1171), 845+ by June. A navigation map that states its own document count is a dated census as well as a finding aid — which is why the superseded versions remain citable as **active historical layers** rather than being replaced.
